notes.title: Update language setting options, players can set the language according...
notes.notes:
This update adds three new languages: Russian, French, and German, and integrates the original English version together. At present, apart from the English version, there is still room for translation in the other three new languages. Finally, because I don't have the money to hire a professional translator, other language versions are all machine translation, please forgive me
